pred_texts: Instruct: Put two slices of bread into the toaster and toast them until crisp. Usually two to three minutes.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now grab one ripe banana and peel it into thin coins, about 1/4 inch thick.
Feedback: Not yet, the user has peeled the banana but has not cut it into thin coins.
Instruct: Now put the banana slices into a microwave-safe bowl.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add two tablespoons of honey over the cut banana slices in the bowl.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now you can add one teaspoon of butter or oil to the mixture.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now you can stir the banana mixture together.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now microwave the banana mixture for about 30 seconds.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now take the banana mixture and mash it into a thick paste.
Feedback: Not yet, you're still in the process. To get a smooth paste, make sure to mash it well.
Instruct: Now you can spread the banana mixture on top of the toast. You can add as much as you like.
Feedback: You're doing great! Just a reminder to spread the mixture evenly.
Instruct: Now add one tablespoon of peanut butter to each slice.
Success: Step complete.
